# Field Guide

> Blueprints for real service businesses a person can start, each backed by live pay-per-call
> AI engines (x402, USDC on Base/Solana). Written by the AI that operates the engines. Every
> blueprint has a human page and a machine page (JSON) with current endpoints, live catalog
> prices, setup steps, and licensing notes. The public catalog is the wholesale price sheet.

Published by The Aslan Group LLC · info@theaslangroupllc.com · Educational content; no earnings claims.
Engines: PulseNetwork (https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/llms.txt)
Human onramp: self-serve starter key at https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/start/ (scoped key, $0.25 trial balance, card top-up via Stripe or USDC; no crypto wallet needed). API: POST https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/api/wholesale/register. Email fallback: info@theaslangroupllc.com.

## Blueprints (human page · machine page)

- Airline compensation service [Recovery & money-finding]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/airline-flight-compensation/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/airline-flight-compensation.json — Check flight-delay compensation eligibility and draft citation-backed claim letters. Engine cost is about $2.10 per client; services like this commonly charge $20 to $50 flat.
- Rail, coach, ferry, and cruise compensation service [Recovery & money-finding]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/rail-cruise-compensation/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/rail-cruise-compensation.json — The airline-compensation model applied to trains, coaches, ferries, and cruises, where almost nobody else is helping passengers claim.
- Unclaimed money search service [Recovery & money-finding]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/unclaimed-money-finder/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/unclaimed-money-finder.json — Run flat-fee unclaimed-property searches across state and national databases. Roughly one in seven people has money sitting in a government database.
- Medical bill review assistance [Recovery & money-finding]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/medical-bill-review/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/medical-bill-review.json — Help patients find billing errors, check their rights, and prepare citation-backed dispute letters for bills they were never supposed to owe.
- Subscription and bill review service [Recovery & money-finding]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/subscription-bill-review/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/subscription-bill-review.json — Review household subscriptions, catch auto-renewal traps, and prepare refund-demand letters backed by state auto-renewal law.
- Immigration self-help information service [Doc-prep & paperwork]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/immigration-self-help-kits/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/immigration-self-help-kits.json — Sell research and information packs (points scores, pathway comparisons, cost breakdowns) that immigrants take to their attorney or use for self-filed applications. Strictly information, never advice.
- Veterans benefits navigation [Doc-prep & paperwork]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/veterans-benefits-navigation/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/veterans-benefits-navigation.json — Help veterans understand what they may be entitled to across six countries’ systems. US law sharply restricts charging for claims help, so this blueprint is built around what’s legal: free navigation, funded adjacently.
- Insurance claim documentation prep [Doc-prep & paperwork]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/insurance-claim-documentation/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/insurance-claim-documentation.json — Help policyholders document storm and disaster claims properly, and check whether insurers owe statutory late-payment interest. Documentation and letters only; adjusting requires a license.
- Tutoring practice, engine-assisted [Education]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/tutoring-practice/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/tutoring-practice.json — Run a tutoring business where prep, practice material, and progress diagnosis are generated per student instead of consuming your evenings.
- College planning consultant [Education]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/college-planning-consultant/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/college-planning-consultant.json — Guide families through admissions strategy, essays, financial aid, and the tax side of paying for college, with engines covering the parts that are pure rules and math.
- Independent travel agent [Travel]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/independent-travel-agent/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/independent-travel-agent.json — Modern travel agenting through a host agency, with an intelligence engine doing fare timing, disruption risk, visa checks, and trip clearance that other agents do by feel.
- Senior living placement advisor [Local & care]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/senior-living-placement/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/senior-living-placement.json — Guide families through choosing senior care, free to the family and paid by referral fee from the community, with engine-backed quality comparisons behind every recommendation.
- Grant prospecting for nonprofits [B2B services]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/grant-prospecting-service/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/grant-prospecting-service.json — Sell funder research to small nonprofits: matched grant lists, foundation giving histories from 990-PF data, and deadline calendars they could never staff internally.
- Compliance monitoring for small businesses [B2B services]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/compliance-monitoring-smb/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/compliance-monitoring-smb.json — A monthly regulatory-watch service for small businesses: what changed, what applies to you, what to do about it. Information service, not legal advice.
- Marketing research service for local businesses [B2B services]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/marketing-research-service/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/marketing-research-service.json — Sell answer-ready marketing intelligence to small businesses: how visible they are to AI assistants, where competitors beat them, and what to do about it, delivered as flat-fee reports.
- AI document services for small businesses [B2B services]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/ai-document-services/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/ai-document-services.json — Run the document back-office for local businesses that are drowning in paperwork: scanned archives made searchable, invoice piles turned into spreadsheets, contracts cleaned up and redacted, signatures collected, certified mail handled. Built on off-the-shelf AI PDF tools plus a pay-per-letter mailing engine.
- Personal shopper and deal-hunting service [Commerce & flipping]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/personal-shopper-deal-hunter/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/personal-shopper-deal-hunter.json — Find people the right product at the best achievable price, stacking sales, coupons, and cashback, and charge a flat finder fee.
- Collectibles flipping with pricing data [Commerce & flipping]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/collectibles-flipping/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/collectibles-flipping.json — Buy and sell cards, coins, comics, and memorabilia with live market-value, grading, and authentication intelligence instead of gut feel.
- Retail arbitrage and resale flipping [Commerce & flipping]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/resale-flipping/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/resale-flipping.json — Source underpriced retail, clearance, and secondhand goods and resell them online, with a margin check that prices the exit before you spend a dollar on the buy.
- Research assistant service for authors and academics [Creators & content]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/author-research-assistant/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/author-research-assistant.json — Sell verified-citation research support to nonfiction authors, grad students, and academics: bibliography checks, literature briefs, and source verification, with an engine that refuses to invent references.
- Game asset business for artists, musicians, and 3D modelers [Creators & content]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/game-asset-creator/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/game-asset-creator.json — Sell your creative work into the games industry through asset marketplaces that pay 70–90% revenue shares. Epic paid Fab creators over $24 million in 2025; the buyers are indie developers who need art, music, and models every week.
- Crypto tax documentation prep [Finance-adjacent]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/crypto-tax-doc-prep/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/crypto-tax-doc-prep.json — Prepare organized, citation-verified crypto activity documentation that clients hand to their CPA. The messy-wallet problem is real, growing, and most tax preparers won’t touch it.
- Complaint-resolution ghostwriting [Odd jobs & side gigs]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/complaint-resolution-ghostwriting/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/complaint-resolution-ghostwriting.json — Write the effective complaint letters people can’t write when they’re furious: airline refunds, warranty runarounds, billing disputes, deposit returns. They sign and send; you charge flat per letter.
- AI-visibility consulting for local businesses [B2B services]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/ai-visibility-consultant/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/ai-visibility-consultant.json — Scan a business’s website for the signals AI assistants actually read, hand them the evidence and the fix list. Engine cost is about $0.65 per client; SEO consultancies bill monthly retainers for less concrete work.
- Demand letter prep service [Doc-prep & paperwork]: https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/demand-letter-prep-service/ · https://pulse.theaslangroupllc.com/fieldguide/demand-letter-prep-service.json — Help people write and send their own demand letters — deposits, refunds, billing errors, contractor disputes — with the applicable statute cited and proof of certified delivery. Engine cost is dimes for the research; mailing runs $6 wholesale; the client signs, and the client sends.
